errors.text_span: the slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top-right
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the slices are arranged in clockwise descending order. Starting from the largest slice ("Right bias", 30%) and moving clockwise, the next slice is "Left center bias" (20%), which is not the next largest. The slices are arranged in a counter-clockwise descending order by size.
